main_body: Stack of cheese wheels: two wide wheels side by side at the bottom (rows 9-14) with a smaller wheel on top (rows 3-9)
top_band: Light yellow top band on the lower wheels at rows 9-11, with a lighter yellow top on the upper wheel at rows 4-7
evidence: Reading down the middle column: the upper wheel has a light top at rows 4-7, then a dark brown shadow band at rows 8-9 under its overhang. Then the lower wheels have a light top band at rows 9-11 with a brighter front-edge highlight, then a mid-gold front face at rows 12-13 and a dark base at row 14. Both a horizontal top surface and a vertical front face are clearly drawn, and there are no receding side faces. The tops are boxy with chamfered corners rather than true ellipses, and the top bands are short (about 3 rows), but they read as surfaces rather than a rim.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 4 tones (pale yellow, gold, mid-gold, dark brown) with a brown-tinted outline, which is acceptable. The front faces and tops are large flat yellow fills with no rind grain, holes or per-wheel texture dots. Each tile carries only about 3-4 colours, against the richer, textured Beodeul cheese stall and well references. It looks thinner and flatter than the reference.
